        How to play

        1. Each wagon carries the completed blocks of one Sepolia settlement batch.
        2. Send every whole wagon to a tunnel, oldest wagon first.
        3. Blocks past a tunnel’s capacity are overflow. Your score is the total, and lower is better.
        4. Try to finish inside a minute. The clock is for fun and never changes your score.

        Press 1, 2 or 3 to send a wagon to tunnel A, B or C. U undoes, R replays the board and N starts a new game.

        An unofficial game for Squeekchain. No wallet, account, tracking or wagers.
